rules.escalation: Clarify unresolved authority or domain decisions before execution; use Max only after a focused High run fails a named check.
Stop on unresolved high-impact assumptions; do not substitute more effort for missing authority or evidence.
Retry validator failures with Terra + Medium; use Sol + High only for isolated deep-judgment exceptions.
Raise effort one step only after a named deterministic check fails.
Move to Sol + High when the failure shows a knowledge or judgment ceiling, not merely verbosity or formatting drift.
Move to Sol + High if architecture, domain knowledge, or repeated verification failures exceed Terra's ceiling.

fallback.escalation: Name the failed check, then raise effort or tier one step according to the failure type.

ultra.note: Ultra is eligible only for explicit parallel decomposition; it is never selected automatically.
